source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/arriving-from-strategic-reserves)** arrives with this move, unless it is embarked in a **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/transports)** that is also in reserves. [Set it up](vsdata:core-rule/set-up) so that:

- the whole unit is within 6" of at least one battlefield edge
- it is horizontally more than 8" from every enemy unit
- before battle round 3, no model is set up in the opponent's deployment zone

Afterwards, unless a rule says otherwise, it cannot make a move of any other type until the next [Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) starts.

eligibility.excluding: a unit carried inside a Transport, where the Transport is in reserves too

arrivalTiming.statedIn: 20.03, which sends every arriving unit through this move

detail.endOfMove: 03.01 Ending a Move applies once the unit has been set up
